description: Return the next step for a flow. Pass the goal (flow id) and the id of the last completed step (omit `after` for the first step). Run each step's detect command FIRST and skip the run command when detection passes. The design step also returns that flow's complete starter ALTER_INTEGRATION.md.

after.description: Id of the last completed step (e.g. "2", "3a").

goal.description: The flow id (setup goal or modify operation).

name: next_step
